title: Golden Sun: The Lost Age
subtitle: The journey continues from another side
summary: Golden Sun: The Lost Age is Camelot's Game Boy Advance role-playing sequel following Felix and his companions in their attempt to restore alchemy to Weyard. Taking characters associated with the opposing side of the first adventure gives the continuing journey another perspective. Psynergy again supplies both battle abilities and tools for environmental puzzles, while a wider structure allows more freedom in the order of several objectives. The sequel turns an unfinished story into another expedition, asking the player to reconsider its larger purpose while exploring more of the same elemental world.
body: Golden Sun: The Lost Age is Camelot's Game Boy Advance role-playing sequel following Felix and his companions in their attempt to restore alchemy to Weyard. Taking characters associated with the opposing side of the first adventure gives the continuing journey another perspective. Psynergy again supplies both battle abilities and tools for environmental puzzles, while a wider structure allows more freedom in the order of several objectives. The sequel turns an unfinished story into another expedition, asking the player to reconsider its larger purpose while exploring more of the same elemental world.

Exploration places more emphasis on returning to locations when another ability or discovery makes further progress possible. Psynergy continues to connect the party with its surroundings, allowing a newly available power to change what an earlier scene permits. The player develops a practical memory of unfinished routes as well as the map of places already visited. This makes the wider journey more than a succession of new destinations. A return can be the important next step once the group finally possesses the means of solving a problem that previously stopped its exploration.

A password system or Game Link Cable can transfer information from the first Golden Sun, preserving aspects of the earlier party and its discoveries within the continuing story. The connection rewards treating the two cartridges as parts of one larger adventure. Djinn collection, turn-based battles and character preparation remain central as Felix's group develops its capabilities. The Lost Age gives those familiar systems another setting and perspective, allowing the accumulated knowledge of how elemental powers work to support a journey whose goals must still be understood through the characters now leading it.
story_headings: The journey continues from another side
Remember the place that still needs a power
The first adventure can travel with the second
